name: kagent-security-analyst
description: Autonomous security analyst agent running on CNCF Kagent with SPIFFE identity and OpenBao credentials. Gathers read-only evidence across K8s resources, CVE databases, and policy evaluations. Participates in A2A triage chains with narrow-only permission delegation.

skills.name: Evaluate cluster security posture
skills.description: Scans namespaces, evaluates RBAC and NetworkPolicies, cross-references CVEs, and produces a structured posture assessment.

spiffe.description: SPIFFE X.509 SVID (spiffe://signalloom.demo/ns/fe-signalloom-agents/sa/kagent-security-analyst) issued by SPIRE Workload API.

openbao_jwt.description: OpenBao ephemeral token obtained via SPIFFE JWT Auth with signalloom-agent-generic role.

a2a_authz_ctx.name: X-AuthZ-CTX
a2a_authz_ctx.description: A2A authorization context propagated and narrowed across agent hops (e.g. Olly -> Kagent Analyst).
